blueprint.scientific_analysis: Frisson in blues is strongly mediated by dopaminergic anticipation-reward cycles, particularly when harmonic violations trigger prediction error signals in the auditory cortex followed by satisfying resolution. blueprint.structure: The track opens with 8 bars of sparse delta blues guitar establishing a hypnotic I-IV groove before sudden complete silence drops for two beats, then full band erupts in an unexpected bVI chord creating harmonic shock.
